bugs.description: make_mht_table() attaches a fixed label vector c('Intercept','In-group Government','In-group Parliament','Out-group Government','Placebo') to summary(model)$coefficients[,4], whose order follows the factor levels (control ref, danger_contr, win_govt, win_mainstream, win_parl). Rows 2, 3 and 5 of Tables D8 and D9 carry the wrong labels: 'In-group Government' shows the Placebo p-value, 'In-group Parliament' shows the In-group Government p-value, 'Placebo' shows the In-group Parliament p-value. The Out-group Government row (position 4) is correct; Bonferroni/Holm adjustments are computed over the same 5 p-values so the adjusted values themselves are unaffected, only their row labels.

class_reason: Per batch2_class_decisions.md #2: T5/T6 (Study 1, half the abstract's main claim) depend on FES data available only behind registration, so materials are not available to the audit and the main class is C. Alternative class on openly available targets T1 to T4: A (all four match the paper to its rounding, and all 22 regenerated Study 2 tables are identical to the deposited ones).
confidence_reason: Study 2 matched exactly by script in a clean library; Study 1 could not be verified at all, and A/B agreement is not yet known to this agent.
uncertainties: T5 and T6 not reproduced (data registration-only); nothing is known from this run about Study 1.

T1 classical p = 0.0461 (from outputs/targets_extracted.csv), close to 0.05; the paper's '*' and conclusion are reproduced, but robust-SE Model 2 p = 0.0967 and two of three pre-registered robustness checks (R_a bootstrap CI includes 0, p 0.086; R_b outlier exclusion p 0.32; R_c ANCOVA p 0.17) do not keep p < 0.05 for T1. Robustness does not change the class.

R_b for T1 drops 2 rows, both in the control arm with swd_ch = 10 (the scale maximum); the estimate moves from -1.27 to -0.54. This reflects the pre-registered |z|>3 rule applied to a bounded change score; recorded as observed, not interpreted.
R_a secondary (LREM) bootstrap CI excludes 0 (upper -0.010, p 0.041) whereas the paper's Model 1 classical p is 0.137 (not significant); R_b and R_c secondary keep 'negative, not significant'.

The Dataverse metadata API (fetched 2026-10-10 12:46 UTC, copy outputs/dataverse_metadata_api_4U8CTG.json) lists 64 files for version 1.0 (35 non-image + 27 PNG, of which 15 in figures_supplementary_materials); PREREG says 66 files and 29 PNG (17 appendix figures). All 35 non-image files listed in PREREG were present with matching sha256 (checksums.sha256). PNGs were not downloaded by either PREREG or this run, so the difference does not touch any input.
Text p. 14 'close to -1.5 points' vs Table D3 Model 1 -1.27, and other text/table inconsistencies listed in PREREG, were not re-examined beyond the targets.
01_manuscript.R was not run (not required by PREREG); code review covered 02 in full (read end to end) and none of 00/01.
Figure outputs were regenerated (outputs/figures_regenerated/) but not compared pixel-wise with the deposited PNGs (not downloaded).

Unverified observation: Table D3 Model 4 (model_4_ez, 02 line 294) controls for income and gender only, while Model 3 and the Le Pen/Others Model 4 use age, gender, educ, income; this matches the deposited table, and whether it is intended could not be determined.
Unverified observation: make_comp_plot (02 lines 751-752) labels m_check3 with difficulty_labels[seq_len(n unique values)], which is correct only if the observed values are exactly 1..k; not checked.
